name: Fuobe drone reveal

dataset.what: Own drone clips flown where flying is allowed: a rising or forward reveal over a landscape or a building; no people who did not sign a release.
captions: Every caption starts with "fbdronereveal, " then says "aerial drone rising reveal" or "aerial drone forward reveal" in the same words each time, then what is in the first frame.
One sentence for what moves and one for what stays still; no text, logos or names.

notes: DroneShot and Set Reveal forbid selling outputs, so the move runs on words until this is trained.
